acceptance_criteria.requirement: Replace the existence-only recovery decision in the legacy micro_task_executor path with authenticated canonical reconciliation. Persist stable workflow/job/node/attempt/idempotency and owner-context lineage before dispatch; bind completed provider/validation outcomes and output digest/schema/provenance to that same attempt. Classify confirmed completion, unconfirmed side effect, and proven never-started separately. No output.json existence or absence alone authorizes completion or retry.

A controlled owned runtime crash after the provider side effect and separately after validation, each before output publication, preserves the uncertain attempt. On restart, independently re-read canonical SurrealDB/EventLedger and the original provider/tool result when available. Resume or retry only with established idempotence or governed reconciliation. When the provider cannot confirm an outcome and has no idempotent retry contract, keep an actionable unconfirmed state; do not assert exactly-once external execution.

Missing, partially written, corrupt, wrong-digest, wrong-schema and foreign-attempt output files cannot complete a step. A valid output whose publication acknowledgement was lost reconciles to its existing attempt without repeating its side effect. Durable completion with missing output is distinguishable from never-started work and can restore the projection from canonical data or retain a precise repair blocker.

Duplicate completion, late completion from a superseded attempt, concurrent resume, and database restart do not duplicate execution, overwrite a newer state or emit conflicting terminal receipts. Compare original immutable attempt identity and current owner/fence at commit and protected publication. Resolve unknown commit acknowledgement by canonical reread under the same idempotency key before any retry.

Preserve existing verified checkpoint recovery, payload hashes, attributed recovery receipts and startup Running-to-Stalled policy. Consume state_recovery through its existing contract; MT-187's ModelLane recovery authorization and original acceptance remain unchanged. Do not replace all recovery, add a parallel controller or turn every Running step into Pending.

Recovery decisions and evidence enforce original account/Principal/AccessSpace/resource context, including revoke/switch races and concurrent accounts. A failed read or denied context cannot silently create a fresh attempt or widen output visibility. Expose stable typed recovery status, reason, provenance and allowed actions for MT-209 without UI-local recovery authority.

Publish the legacy replay projection contract and same-change UserManual/Argus obligations with MT-209. Flight Recorder records business decisions and EventLedger linkage; internal_diagnostics records mechanical failure/latency state; standalone Palmistry records owned process liveness/crash evidence only. No fixture, output filename, receipt authored by the implementer or mock provider substitutes for independent real production-boundary proof.
